causality_disclaimer: Observed correlation, regression association, or ML/SHAP feature importance reflects statistical co-movement and predictive utility only; it does NOT establish causation.

rainfall_mm.native_frequency: daily (aggregated to weekly totals/means/rainy-days and 1..8 week lags)
rainfall_mm.district_coverage: 35 / 36 Maharashtra districts (34 strict nearest grid cell + Gadchiroli via 3x3 neighborhood fallback; Mumbai Suburban has no coordinates)

temperature_tmin_tmax_tavg_diurnal.source: IMD 1.0x1.0 deg daily gridded NetCDF (imdweb_Oe9H04Bg.nc, imdweb_tXexQbB6.nc)
temperature_tmin_tmax_tavg_diurnal.native_frequency: daily (aggregated to weekly means, extremes, diurnal range, and 1..8 week lags)
temperature_tmin_tmax_tavg_diurnal.note_on_tavg: No standalone tavg raw file; derived as 0.5 * (tmin_c + tmax_c)

relative_humidity_pct.date_range: 2024-05-11 to 2025-06-09 (395 valid daily aggregates after removing <0 or >100 sensor spikes)
relative_humidity_pct.native_frequency: sub-hourly telemetry aggregated to daily and weekly means
relative_humidity_pct.district_coverage: 1 / 36 districts (Pune ONLY; 0% coverage in the other 35 districts)

historical_2009_2022_note.reason: Zero temporal overlap between 2009-2022 EpiClim records and 2023-2025 IMD/CWPRS climate files.
